name: Izhar
summary: A quiescent noon or tanween keeps its own sound before a throat letter.

name: Ikhfaa
summary: A quiescent noon or tanween is hidden as a hum held at the following letter's place.

name: Iqlab
summary: A quiescent noon or tanween becomes a hummed meem before baa.

name: Idgham bi-Ghunnah
summary: A quiescent noon or tanween merges into the letter after it and the hum is kept.

name: Idgham bila-Ghunnah
summary: A quiescent noon or tanween merges into a following lam or raa with no hum.

name: Ghunnah Mushaddadah
summary: A doubled noon or meem is held on its hum.

name: Izhar Shafawi
summary: A quiescent meem keeps its own sound before a letter that is neither meem nor baa.

name: Ikhfaa Shafawi
summary: A quiescent meem is hidden as a hum on the lips before baa.

name: Idgham Shafawi
summary: A quiescent meem merges into a following meem.

name: Idgham Mutamathilayn
summary: A quiescent letter merges into an identical letter after it.

name: Idgham Mutaqaribayn
summary: A quiescent letter merges into a letter of a near place after it.

name: Idgham Mutajanisayn Kamil
summary: A quiescent letter merges completely into a letter of its own place.

name: Idgham Mutajanisayn Naqis
summary: A quiescent letter merges into a letter of its own place but keeps a trait of its own.

name: Lam Shamsiyyah
summary: The article's lam merges into the sun letter after it.

name: Lam Qamariyyah
summary: The article's lam keeps its own sound before a moon letter.

name: Qalqala Sughra
summary: A quiescent qalqala letter inside the reading is released with a light echo.

name: Qalqala Kubra
summary: A qalqala letter the stop makes quiescent is released with a fuller echo.

name: Qalqala Akbar
summary: A doubled qalqala letter stopped on is released with the fullest echo.

name: Tafkheem
summary: The letter is sounded heavy, and a fatha on it with it.

name: Tarqeeq
summary: The raa is sounded light.

name: Imala
summary: A long aa is tilted towards a long ee.

name: Tashil
summary: A hamza is eased rather than fully articulated.

name: Ishmam
summary: The lips round for a vowel that is not sounded.

name: Madd Tabii
summary: A long vowel is held for its plain length, with nothing after it to extend it.

name: Madd Muttasil
summary: A long vowel is extended before a hamza in the same word.

name: Madd Munfasil
summary: A long vowel is extended before a hamza opening the next word.

name: Madd Lazim
summary: A long vowel is extended before a letter the reading keeps quiescent.

name: Madd Arid Lissukun
summary: A long vowel is extended before a letter the stop makes quiescent.

name: Madd Leen
summary: A waw or yaa after a fatha is extended before a letter the stop makes quiescent.

name: Madd Iwad
summary: A fathatan stopped on is exchanged for a long aa.

name: Madd Badal
summary: A long vowel on a hamza stands in for a second hamza the reading does not say.

name: Madd Silah
summary: A pronoun haa is drawn out because the word is joined to the one after it.

name: Ibdal Hamza
summary: Started on, a prosthetic hamza lengthens its vowel over the quiescent hamza after it.

name: Hamza Wasl Silent
summary: A prosthetic hamza is not sounded when the word before it is joined to it.

name: Hamza Wasl with Fatha
summary: A prosthetic hamza the reading starts on is sounded with a fatha.

name: Hamza Wasl with Kasra
summary: A prosthetic hamza the reading starts on is sounded with a kasra.

name: Hamza Wasl with Damma
summary: A prosthetic hamza the reading starts on is sounded with a damma.

name: Iltiqa Haraka
summary: A letter takes a haraka so that it does not meet the quiescent letter after it.

name: Iltiqa Shortening
summary: A long vowel is shortened where it would meet a quiescent letter.

name: Waqf Diacritic Drop
summary: A haraka or tanween written at the end of a word stopped on is not sounded.

name: Waqf Silah Drop
summary: The length drawing out a pronoun haa is absent when the word is stopped on.

name: Taa Marbuta at a Pause
summary: A final taa marbuta is sounded as a haa at a stop.

name: Pausal Alif
summary: A pausal alif is sounded long at a stop and shortened where the word is joined to the one after it.

name: Orthographic Silence
summary: A letter the script writes and no reading ever says.

name: Variant Silence
summary: A written letter the selected reading option leaves unsaid.
